scope: One original and one subsequently disclosed exact candidate run, stdlib actual IPv4 loopback transport only. No PayPal requests, installation, provider settings, native host action, or repository mutation.

cases.expect: Without LEDGERLY_ALLOW_NETWORK=1, construction raises the existing exact RuntimeError before any transport invocation.

OAuth form/Basic authentication remains exact and declares timeout 20. A POST with nested Unicode JSON and extra headers returns Response(201, exact parsed JSON); API declares timeout 30; success response is closed.
A subsequent empty 204 returns Response(204, None), closes response, reuses cached token, and preserves the unique request ID.

A real 503 response whose advertised body never completes produces the original TimeoutError; HTTPError wrapper, HTTPResponse, and captured socket-backed file are closed before escape. Only the fixture's actual transport timeout is shortened to 0.20s, while the product's requested timeout remains recorded as 30.

A real 503 response that closes after a short body produces http.client.IncompleteRead with exact partial and missing-byte count; HTTPError wrapper, response and captured file are closed before escape.

A real 422 Unicode JSON body preserves PayPalError type, status, name/message, first detail, formatted message, debug ID shape, HTTPError exception context, request data and timeout. HTTPError and its resources are already closed at PayPalError construction and after escape.

shared_checks: One auth request across the five actual API calls, expected local paths/methods/body/headers, no requests outside the exact bound loopback origin.
Each captured API request ID is a distinct 32-character lowercase hexadecimal value.
Capture resources before product handling, observe closed states before fixture cleanup, then close retained resources and release/join all owned server work.
Capture original and candidate source/supporting hashes before and after. Supporting files must match original. No bytecode or product file writes.
Record actual outcomes and assertion failures without inferring cause, expanding cases, changing expectations, or rerunning a completed course.
limitations: Transport timeout shortening is an explicit local fixture seam, not a change to product source or its requested timeout.
Synthetic local transport only; no PayPal authentication or service acceptance.
